text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] paging error rate spike for /v1/streaming - synths showing 422 on continue/paged calls. Severity: high
sre_jamie: seeing it in Grafana, spike started ~3m after deploy in us-west-2 canary
eng_liz: rolled SDK v3.4.1 canary 3m ago; quick glance shows handshake mismatch in logs
oncall_miguel: taking oncall, assigning P0. I'll grab traces and set incident channel.
eng_liz: repro with SDK 3.4.1 + runtime v2.9 against paged endpoints - client sends new frame field that runtime rejects
sre_jamie: can we disable the feature flag for the SDK-side paging change? where's the flag path?
eng_liz: it's under rollout.service -> feature.flags.paging_client_v3. @devops FYI
oncall_miguel: flipping paging_client_v3 -> false now (doing via rollout API)
incident-bot: feature flag "paging_client_v3" set to false by oncall_miguel
eng_liz: metrics show immediate drop in 422 errors on canary pods, still watching 1m
pm_raja: customer impact: CS called out 3 active sessions that saw disconnects, no data corruption reported. Preparing customer note.
cs_olivia: notifying affected customers: sent template "We observed transient streaming errors affecting paged sessions; we rolled back the client change and are investigating."
oncall_miguel: errors down to baseline, initiating canary rollback of SDK v3.4.1 from 20% -> 0%
eng_liz: rollback completed. Will publish 3.4.1-hotfix build that reverts the protocol bump and add e2e gating.
sre_jamie: opening follow-up ticket: incident-1788887777 - add protocol compatibility tests, block autopromote.
pm_raja: scheduling postmortem tomorrow 09:00 PT, include engineering, SRE, CS. Thanks team, tagging as mitigated for now.
